svg.title: Every decision has a history. Nouli is a ledger-backed decision network. The README's recall example as a line map: three source sessions blend in two layers into recall-response-updated, which is built on six earlier decisions.
svg.text: Nouli is a ledger-backed decision network that records AI decisions
and connects them to the facts and earlier answers they use.
THE RECALL GRAPH · nouli view recall-response-updated · recorded
All jars matched to a lot? P(yes) 0.07
